$comment: Limits of text slots that no visible box measures (read by packages/cms/tracy-quickstart-tools/content-coverage/emdash-content-map.mjs into the content map). A number needs a real source: a box that was measured (how is said in `from`) or a field's schema maxLength (none of these fields declares one). A text no page draws in a box has no number: it is declared `nonVisual` with where it is used, and the kit asks no limit of it.

limits.from: the site title is used only in the document `<title>` and `og:site_name` (Base.astro) and as the logo's alt text when the brand has no name of its own: no page draws it in a box and the setting declares no maxLength, so it has no limit (the business name the footer prints is its own slot, chrome.brand_name, which is measured)
